notes.title: First Major Update Adds So Many Things
notes.content:
The first major update is coming on May the 25th, and it is packed with goodies. 

There are so many things to list. I don't want to tell you them all, I want everyone to discover them, but here are some things that I can bring up. 

There are new things to do and new rare events. You can get a job, have a drink or maybe do some dancing for money.

The store has been redesigned inside and there are many more food options available. Maybe you'll want to guzzle hot sauce without paying? You might go to jail for stealing, you might go crazy from hot sauce or both! Cool down the spice with some milk from the new freezers. Smash bottles like a champ and light some fires.

You can lay down on the bed to sleep through the night, or maybe do a night job and earn some extra money. Be careful, or you may see aliens or other dark creatures.

Going insane is now something that you have to deal with and there are a few things you can do to settle your mind and come back down to reality. Have a smoke to calm your nerves, or take some pills if you have the money. Don't take too much, or you might get addicted, and if you do you'll need to keep up that addiction.

There are many secrets to discover.

Still working on getting the Oculus system mapped out.

notes.title: First big update let's you put the toilet seat down
notes.content:
[h1][b]This update comes with a lot of fixes and a couple new features.[/b][/h1]

-The criminal level was broken and people kept being sent back to jail. This has been fixed
-The amount of time spent in jail has been corrected
-Days and nights did not transition properly, and now they should
-Wine bottles now smash
-Wine bottles are now filled with liquid. Beer is next
-Pee was not showing. This has been fixed
-Vomit was not showing. This has been fixed
-Toilet seat flaps*
-There is a new microwave with better functionality
-Frozen burritos have been added
-New freezers have been added
-The sink water now should be working
-Basic transitions have been set in place
-Punching now is based on force
-Newspapers are in place and will begin showing regular news upon the next update
-Secrets

*The toilet seat in the corner shop bathroom can now be set in the up or down position. This is vitally important to the game and many sleepless nights were spent getting it just right. Now you can lift the seat, or lower the seat, depending on your desired preference. Finally, a piece of truly essential gameplay has been implemented for the masses. Use it wisely, hobos.
